texture: Hand painted low-poly game character. Clear flat color blocks: pale blue short jacket, bright sky-blue satchel and sash, tan trousers, dark curly hair. Minimal surface noise, readable at mobile battle size.

Curly dark hair, compact pale blue scholar robe with short sleeves, wide sky-blue waist wrap, small brown satchel and boots. Boyish compact silhouette, distinct pale blue color block. No lightsaber.
